topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: I was clearing out the old garden, just preparing for the new season, when my spade hit something solid. I bent down, brushing away the dirt to uncover a small, rusted box. It was unmistakably a time capsule, the kind people bury with items meant to capture a moment in time. But I couldn’t for the life of me recall ever burying this. The realization made my fingers tingle, and I carefully lifted the box, dusting it off, my heart pounding a bit faster. Inside, the contents were a mystery, a silent whisper from the past, beckoning me to uncover its secrets. Each object inside, wrapped in yellowed paper, seemed to hum with stories, connecting me to a moment I didn’t even know existed.
